title: Pantalone Privacy Policy
content:
Last updated: 1 April 2026

Pantalone iOS

This Privacy Policy applies exclusively to the Pantalone iOS app (the App), available on the Apple App Store. It does not apply to the Pantalone website or any web-based versions of Match or Slide, which are covered by a separate privacy policy.

About the App

Pantalone is a puzzle game app developed by Samuel Wood, currently offering two games: Match, a card-flipping memory game, and Slide, a tile-ordering puzzle game.

Data Collection

The App itself does not directly collect, store, or process any personal data. The App integrates with Apple Game Center to provide leaderboard and score-sharing features. Through Game Center, Apple may process your Game Center username, game scores, and contacts for Game Center's sharing features. This data is collected and managed entirely by Apple and is subject to Apple's own Privacy Policy, which can be found at apple.com/legal/privacy. Samuel Wood has no access to, and no control over, the data Apple collects through Game Center.

Third Parties

The App contains no third-party advertising, analytics SDKs, or tracking of any kind.

Children

The App does not knowingly collect any data from any user, including children.

Changes to This Policy

If the App's data practices change in future — for example, through the introduction of new features — this policy will be updated accordingly.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact: hello@pantalone.games
